caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of translucent teal with visible highlights and shadows indicating its glassy, reflective surface. The object features a broad base with scalloped or petal-like edges, a rounded, bulbous body, a slender neck flaring out at the rim, and an ornate curved handle that attaches at the neck and upper body. Decorative, curved glass elements curl around the body near the base of the neck, and there is a pronounced pouring spout at the top. There are no other objects in the drawing. The artist's signature, “Van. Silvay.,” appears in small, gray letters at the bottom right of the composition.
title: Pitcher
